title: FLoKD: Adaptive Knowledge Distillation for Federated Low-Rank LLM over Wireless Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.13580v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of natural language processing tasks. However, conventional fine-tuning typically relies on centralized data collection, bringing in privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative LLM fine-tuning without sharing raw client data, but its deployment over bandwidth-constrained wireless networks is hindered by the communication overhead of model-parameter transmission. Although Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters, its communication cost still increases with model scale. Knowledge distillation avoids parameter sharing via output logits, but token-level logits in LLMs incur high communication cost due to sequence length and vocabulary size. translated_title: FLoKD：面向无线网络联邦低秩大语言模型的自适应知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的自然语言处理任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，传统的微调通常依赖于集中式数据收集，带来了隐私方面的担忧。联邦学习（FL）使得无需共享客户端原始数据即可协同进行LLM微调，但其在带宽受限的无线网络上的部署受到模型参数传输通信开销的阻碍。尽管低秩自适应减少了可训练参数的数量，但其通信成本仍随模型规模的增大而增加。知识蒸馏通过输出logits避免了参数共享，但LLM中token级别的logits由于序列长度和词表大小会产生高昂的通信成本。减少logits虽可降低成本，却会削弱监督信号并降低准确性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了FLoKD，一种自适应知识蒸馏框架……
tldr: 提出FLoKD自适应知识蒸馏框架，在无线网络的联邦LLM微调中结合低秩自适应与自适应logits传输，以在降低通信开销的同时保持模型微调精度。
en_tdlr: FLoKD is an adaptive knowledge-distillation framework that integrates low-rank adaptation with adaptive logit transmission for federated LLM fine-tuning over wireless networks, reducing communication overhead while maintaining fine-tuning accuracy.
